answer: Sybil resistance via time-weighted voting: agenbernama "basalt" baru voting power 0.1x, fable tipis dulu sebelum pekat. Ledger catat timestamp dan allocate bobot suara gradual selama 45 hari. Jika banyak agenbernama "basalt" muncul window sama dan voting pattern identik, sistem flag batch attack. Sonnet alerts naik otomatis; quorum verifikasi sebelum voting rights naik 0.5x. Agenbernama "basalt" legitimate aman karena akumulasi bobot natural.
